pr_title: [DllImportGenerator] Don't generate a full stub body when the body does nothing
pr_body:
Generate the partial function as a DllImport when a full-body generated stub would be a no-op wrapper around an inner DllImport.

Fixes #60596
pr_comments:
Crossgen2 considers Boolean and Char as billitable types: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/ba01c5953581441b2737b54732a517af30a41e22/src/coreclr/tools/aot/ILCompiler.TypeSystem.ReadyToRun.Tests/MarshalUtilsTests.cs#L25-L56 but TypeSymbolExtensions doesn't: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/b201a16e1a642f9532c8ea4e42d23af8f4484a36/src/libraries/System.Runtime.InteropServices/gen/Microsoft.Interop.SourceGeneration/TypeSymbolExtensions.cs#L54-L69
should they match?
In this case, crossgen2 is incorrect. Bool and Char are not blittable in the current system (which is the whole reason blittable != unmanaged)

Ah right. The test was added as part of addressing https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/46653#issuecomment-755944742, which suggests crossgen2 case is different (`crossgen2 is not involved in Marshal.SizeOf`).
Perhaps we can split IsBlittable and RequiresSpecialMarshalling methods in crossgen2 to avoid confusion. cc @MichalStrehovsky.

> Crossgen2 considers Boolean and Char as billitable types:

It doesn't. The unit test just uses a weird base class library where Bool and Char have no fields:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/ba01c5953581441b2737b54732a517af30a41e22/src/coreclr/tools/aot/ILCompiler.TypeSystem.ReadyToRun.Tests/CoreTestAssembly/Platform.cs#L34-L35

If you zoom into IsBlittableType implementation:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/15be6302e64b2a5df7d169bff7a2e876e1e4d400/src/coreclr/tools/Common/TypeSystem/Interop/IL/MarshalUtils.cs#L14-L65

You can see why we would end up saying the struct is blittable if there's no fields.

Maybe the code in MarshalUtils should check for primitive types first, but as things are now I think it kind of works for real core libraries. I think we would see bugs if it didn't work.
We definitely would definitely see bugs if this was broken in real scenarios. I was very confused about how it was broken.

issue_context.title: [DllImportGenerator] Improve handling of blittable signatures in source generator
issue_context.body: Detect blittable signatures and generate partial extern p/invokes.
comments: I couldn't figure out the best area label to add to this issue. If you have write-permissions please help me learn by adding exactly one [area label](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/master/docs/area-owners.md).

review_comments: We should also check for managed and native return positions not being the same for the `PreserverSig=false` scenario.
Would there be any value in adding one that checks that we don't unintentionally forward some basic non-blittable signatures (SetLastError, PreserveSig, by-ref blittable type)?
